sn23.21:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Samudayadhammo samudayadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante samudayadhammoti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha samudayadhammo || vedanā samudayadhammo || saññā || saṅkhārasamudayadhammo || viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammo || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
